brainlife.desc: Connectome Workbench style cortical surface folder: GIFTI surfaces (surf/), mapped measures (func/) and parcellation labels (label/) per hemisphere.
brainlife.name: neuro/cortexmap
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Analysing diffusion, myelin or other measures mapped onto the cortical midthickness surface. Per-parcel surface statistics and group averaging on a standard mesh.

**Not for:** Group averaging before resampling every subject to the same standard mesh.

**BIDS:** anat/dseg (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 28 Apps, output of 27 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.cortexmap.json

files.desc: Folder with surf/, func/ (.func.gii) and label/ (.label.gii) GIFTI files per hemisphere.

identifying_risks: Individual cortical geometry and measures are participant-level
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Share with participant codes only, inside a controlled project
tier_conditions: Tier 1 when averaged across enough participants that no individual can be singled out
